description: This is a React component source file defining the SuperNoteImporter component for a note importing/convert feature in a web application. It manages note conversion, preview, and user interactions within a modal dialog.

classes.name: SuperNoteImporter
classes.description: A React FunctionComponent that handles the import and conversion of notes into a custom 'Super' format, including user interaction, preview, and conversion logic.

methods.name: confirmConvert
methods.description: Handles the confirmation process to convert a note, including user confirmation and initiating the conversion.

methods.name: convertAsIs
methods.description: Converts the note without modifications, after user confirmation, possibly returning it to a JSON-like plain text format.
